propositions: The enrich drain gate check scales linearly with ticket count (O(N)), consuming 486-740ms on a 4,835-ticket store against a declared 20ms budget, creating a 25x overrun on every write.
The gate's full-store walk issues ~24,000 filesystem metadata operations per write via pending_enrichment calling reduce_ticket for every ticket dir, each doing 3x listdir and 2x isdir.
Under concurrent agent load, the gate's cost compounds through self-contention on vnode cache saturation rather than CPU, causing 490ms baseline to reach 2300+ms with ~10 concurrent walkers.
The budget-breach warning fires on 100% of writes in real stores, rendering it useless as an observability signal for genuine future breaches.
pending_enrichment must be made O(1) for quiet stores via a marker tracking next_eligible_ns, degrades safely to full scan if marker is missing/corrupt/stale, invalidates on every queue append.
